facts.claim: Hilton Honors on-property benefits (free standard Wi-Fi, MyWay benefits such as breakfast or a daily food-and-beverage credit, space-available upgrades) need a reservation made through a Hilton direct channel, the hotel, or an IATA travel agent booking through a Hilton channel or Amadeus, Apollo Galileo, Worldspan or SABRE; they are not awarded on third-party website, opaque or third-party package bookings.

facts.claim: The Hilton Honors Discount is from 2% off the eligible rate, depending on booking window, region or country, day of the week and other circumstances; up to four rooms per member per stay; not combinable with other offers and not valid for existing reservations or groups.

facts.claim: Hilton's Price Match Guarantee: book directly with Hilton, claim within 24 hours; a qualifying rate at least 1% lower (same room, view, terms, guests and dates; public, bookable by anyone, no login, code or app-only price; hotel's currency; still available at review) is matched with a further 25% off the room rate for the stay. Not after check-in; member, corporate, package and group rates excluded; Hampton by Hilton and SLH hotels in the PRC and Partner Accommodations in AU, AT, BE, CZ, DE, FR, IT, PT and CH excluded. Terms apply to claims from 20 August 2026.

articles/direct-booking-vs-otas-hotel-gu: takes a further 25% off the room rate for your stay

facts.claim: Marriott's Best Rate Guarantee: Bonvoy members only; book through a direct Marriott channel; claim within 24 hours of booking and at least 24 hours before check-in; the comparison rate must be more than 1% lower (2% with currency conversion); Marriott matches it and adds 25% off (20% at Design Hotels) or 5,000 Bonvoy points.
